bio.text: Justin Early is running for Congress, according to his campaign website, which says he lives in Georgetown with his wife, Toni.

The website says he enlisted in the U.S. Army after graduating from Leander High School in 1998, served as a paratrooper at Fort Bragg, and later worked as a LAN systems administrator at the Defense Intelligence Agency.
According to the website, he is a cybersecurity architect at Dell Technologies and previously served as a Democratic precinct chair in Tarrant County.

sources.title: Meet Justin — Justin Early for Congress
